text_block_list.text:
Back when I first met Narita Brian,
several
months before her
astonishing win in the
Satsuki Sho...
Her running was, in a word, "restrained."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gaaah... This's haaard!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good run, you two! Keep it up! You'll be
ready for the next race in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's some things you can't get just by
running! What that is
exactly... I'll tell you
when I think of it!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, okay then. Anyway, that's enough
training for today. Good job,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoo-hoo! Time to eat! Later, alligator!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
See you tomorrow... Huh? Over there, is
that...

I follow Winning Ticket's gaze and find a
racer training tirelessly.
Exhale...
Hup!
She moves flexibly, with powerful strides.

It's not bad running at first glance, but
something isn't quite in sync.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's Hayahide's little sister,
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but why's she out here training
alone? Shouldn't she be with
the rest of
her team?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Her team... So she's debuted already?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's run five races, I think,
with two
wins so far. It's not bad,
but I get the
feeling it could be better.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
After all, Hayahide gushes over Brian—she
calls her a huuuge heap of
talent!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: A heap of talent, huh?

The analytical Biwa Hayahide, a heap of
talent in her own right,
would praise her
sister that much?

Hearing that alone would've piqued my
interest, but then... Not long
after, I find
Narita Brian again in an unexpected place.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
There are some major athletes at these
tryouts. I've really gotta think
things
through before scouting anyone.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Narita Brian's up next, but didn't she
debut already?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I heard she dropped out of her team.
Things weren't working out with
her
trainer.

Tryouts are where racers who don't have a
team yet try to be scouted
by a trainer.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(Now I get why she was training on her
own, but what happened with
her trainer
that made her quit?)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(Now I get why she was training on her
own, but what happened with
her trainer
that made her quit?)

While I'm still pondering that,
Brian's race
begins.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Narita Brian finishes five lengths
behind first! Did she lose all her
energy
before the last sprint?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
With two Twinkle Series wins under her
belt, it's hard to believe her
result today!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That was a great run! I'd love to have you
on our team!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! I'd love to join!

Seeing the other trainers approaching
Umamusume, I head over to
the racer who
caught my interest.

Seeing the other trainers approaching
Umamusume, I head over to
the racer who
caught my interest.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hey, Narita Brian. Mind if we talk?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I did anything today worthy
of being scouted.

She's right—she didn't display much of a
performance and lost speed
near the end.

Yet I can't help but think that awkward
running form of hers is to
blame. And I
have to know if I'm right.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Your flexibility and momentum were good.
Perfect form as well.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Your flexibility and momentum were good.
Perfect form as well.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I think those pieces aren't fitting
together well.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Your form's too textbook. It's holding back your power.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Your form's too textbook. It's holding back your power.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Try running more freely, and let your
strength guide you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: More freely... as my strength guides me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hup!
Whatever I was expecting, it wasn't this.

Her stance is so low, she looks like an
animal on the hunt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what's up with that run?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wow... And she keeps getting faster!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Haha... She really is a heap of talent.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Haha... She really is a heap of talent.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you ran like that in the race, you
would've placed first for sure.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you ran like that in the race, you
would've placed first for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I still have to think about it too much.
Once I get the hang of it, I'll be
even
faster.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Even faster than that? Well, can't say I'm
not looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Even faster than that? Well, can't say I'm
not looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind me asking, why'd you
leave your team? Your trainer
must've
been proud that you racked up two wins.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind me asking, why'd you
leave your team? Your trainer
must've
been proud that you racked up two wins.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Because I want to run more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Apparently I don't get consistent results
because I don't know how to
keep my
composure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So they said I needed to take a break from
racing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Composure, huh...

She must not have a good handle on her
excitement when she's
competing.

It's important to be hyped up, but a racer
also needs to keep cool
when making
critical, split-second decisions.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't accept that explanation or
their decision.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I understand why my trainer made that call, but I simply disagree. Nothing more, nothing less.

Wanting to run is as simple as it gets,
and
she's certainly strong-willed
to leave her
team over that.

And she has the ability to turn that
passion
into raw physical power!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If we start now, we could still make the
Kyoto Junior Stakes. There's
the G1 Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
If we start now, we could still make the
Kyoto Junior Stakes. There's
the G1 Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Rather than hold back your desire to
run, I
think it'd be better to
channel it through
more races. So...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Rather than hold back your desire to
run, I
think it'd be better to
channel it through
more races. So...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, I was at the tryouts to get
scouted. The run just now was so
much
more impactful, I forgot why I was even
here.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Let's try out that new running style in
the
next race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You got it.
I'll take any chance I can get to
run!

And so, Narita Brian becomes the newest
member of Team Sirius.

I'll soon get to see exactly how boundless
her talent really is.
